definition: a line or route leading to a place
description: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.
transcript: Excuse me, coming through. You going or am I going? Okay, I'm going.
